Buildings are becoming power generators with integrated renewable energy systems. Solar panels, wind turbines, and geothermal heating are standard features in modern construction. These systems reduce operating costs and carbon footprints. Designers must consider energy efficiency from the ground up. Smart building technologies optimize energy use, making renewable integration both practical and profitable for property owners. Solar Integration Roof-mounted panels provide clean electricity. Building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV) serve as both energy generators and architectural elements. Energy storage systems ensure power availability 24/7. Wind and Geothermal Small wind turbines suit certain building types. Geothermal systems provide heating and cooling with high efficiency.
